nodes.label: DirScanner
nodes.rationale: Standalone directory scanner utility for finding files matching criteria; not embedded in Reader to allow reuse across contexts.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.rationale: Security foundation for all file-based adapters, preventing path traversal, symlink escape, and unauthorized access to hidden files.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.rationale: Provides safe file writes with atomic replace semantics using temporary files to prevent data corruption.

nodes.label: Graph
nodes.rationale: Pure infrastructure for directed graphs; handles raw structure and adjacency without serialization constraints.

nodes.label: DagGraph
nodes.rationale: Validated DAG wrapper that caches topological order and roots for efficient traversal and hierarchy resolution.

nodes.label: Note (Concept)
nodes.rationale: A single vault document represented as domain state; vault files are the source of truth.

nodes.label: Frontmatter (Concept)
nodes.rationale: Structured metadata block at the beginning of a note used for schema-based validation and discovery.

nodes.label: Task (Concept)
nodes.rationale: Checklist item extracted from note content; distinct from structural list items.

nodes.label: Note
nodes.rationale: Aggregate root consolidating all extracted facts about a markdown file; optimized for storage density and zero-copy access.

nodes.label: NoteId
nodes.rationale: Stable identifier using UUID v7 for time-ordered efficiency in database indexing.

nodes.label: NoteError
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical umbrella error type for the Note domain, preserving context across the ingestion pipeline.

nodes.label: NoteEvent
nodes.rationale: Audit record for note lifecycle changes, supporting incremental indexing and event-driven updates.

nodes.label: Frontmatter
nodes.rationale: Type-safe API for accessing YAML/TOML metadata while handling unquoted WikiLinks and Obsidian-specific nuances.

nodes.label: InlineField
nodes.rationale: Metadata fields embedded in markdown text (key:: value), allowing structured data attachment to any content.

nodes.label: Link
nodes.rationale: Models wiki-links and markdown links with anchor and alias support for rich document relationships.

nodes.label: ListItem
nodes.rationale: Represents the physical presence of a bullet in the source file, capturing structural nesting and list semantics.

nodes.label: RawAssembler
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the conversion from parser IR (DocTree/Events) to raw domain artifacts (RawNote).
